change: No structural changes to muscles. Reordered secondary entries to place Posterior Deltoid before Biceps Brachii for clarity (Posterior Deltoid is a more meaningful synergist in shoulder extension; Biceps role is minimal in this kneeling pullover/pulldown due to limited elbow flexion). All groups and latins verified correct.

Removed abs secondary entry (Upper Rectus Abdominis, LowerRectus Abdominis). The cable pull through is a hip-hinge pattern; core stabilization is primarily isometric deep core and erector spinae, not rectus abdominis. Sources confirm secondary muscles are erector spinae, adductor magnus, and soleus — not rectus abdominis. Also removed Calves/Soleus secondary: sources mention soleus only in passing; the hip-hinge pattern does not meaningfully load the soleus. Kept Lower Back (Erector Spinae) and Adductors as secondaries.

No changes. The silverback shrug involves both scapular retraction and elevation; Upper Traps, Rhomboids, and Lower Traps are all legitimately engaged. Posterior Deltoid and Rotator Cuff as secondaries confirmed correct for horizontal cable pulling patterns.

Removed abs secondary (Upper Rectus Abdominis, LowerRectus Abdominis). Single-leg deadlift core stabilization is driven by obliques and deep stabilizers rather than rectus abdominis specifically. Replaced abs with oblique (External Obliques, Internal Obliques) — confirmed by EMG research: unilateral hip-hinge requires anti-rotation oblique engagement. Gluteus Medius kept as co-primary (confirmed as primary pelvic stabilizer on single-leg stance).

Added oblique (External Obliques, Internal Obliques) as secondary — confirmed by sources: unilateral squat pattern requires oblique anti-rotation stabilization. Expanded Calves secondary from Soleus only to include Gastrocnemius Lateral and Gastrocnemius Medial — sources list gastrocnemius medial as a stabilizer in cable split squat; including full Calves entry is more complete and accurate.
